ideas.title: Kratom sold as a 'wellness' supplement is driving opioid-like addiction: what's in the packets and why it's still on shelves
ideas.angle: A short, sharp item on the wellness-to-dependence pipeline: 'natural' and 'plant-based' marketing versus withdrawal reality. Tie it to last week's HHS wellness-peptides opening as part of the same lax-regulation pattern.
ideas.why_now: A fresh NYT Well investigation ran 11/2–11/3.
ideas.is_it_real: The NYT reporting is credible but it is the only source here. A full pitch would need a fresh angle beyond the NYT, so this works best as a roundup item. Confirm with FDA warnings or poison-control data before stating any numbers.

ideas.title: Vitamin C in pregnancy linked to baby brain development: what the study actually shows
ideas.angle: Cover what the study found and what it can't prove. Explain why 'linked to' isn't 'causes,' and why it isn't a reason to megadose beyond a prenatal vitamin.
ideas.why_now: The study was published 11/2 and is circulating through MedicalXpress.
ideas.is_it_real: The headline is accurate per the upstream check. It is likely observational, so the item must not imply causation. Source design and size need confirming from the paper.
